name: openbb_fixedincome_sofr
description:
Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) history with percentiles and volume through the OpenBB Platform (obb.fixedincome.rate.sofr); rates are decimals (0.0433 = 4.33%).
Returns: {tool, provider, data_points (rows before the cap), truncated, data: rows with their dates, ignored_arguments when some did not apply} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): start_date and end_date (provider's default window when omitted); limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (federal_reserve, fred; default federal_reserve).
Other overnight rates: openbb_fixedincome_effr, openbb_fixedincome_estr, openbb_fixedincome_iorb. Keys: federal_reserve needs none; fred uses SAJHA's FRED_API_KEY.
Example: {"start_date": "2026-09-01"}

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
